topics.title: Present simple vagy present continuous?
topics.intro: Az angolban két jelen idő van. A present simple a rendszeres, általános dolgokra, a present continuous az éppen most zajló vagy ideiglenes dolgokra való. A magyar ezt nem különbözteti meg, ezért ez az egyik leggyakoribb hiba.

head: Present simple
Present continuous
rows: I am working, she is working
I don't work, she doesn't work
Do you work? Does she work?
now, at the moment, this week

points: Rendszeres: I go to the gym on Mondays.
Általános igazság: Water boils at 100 degrees.
Most zajlik: I'm reading a great book at the moment.
Ideiglenes: She's staying with her parents this month.
Állapotigék (know, like, want, believe, understand) általában nem állnak -ing alakban: I know him. (nem: I'm knowing)
mistakes: I am work here. → I work here.
She work in a bank. → She works in a bank. (-s egyes szám 3. személyben!)
I'm understanding. → I understand.

drill.q: Listen! Somebody ___ at the door.
She ___ to work by bus every day.
drill.why: Rendszeres cselekvés, egyes szám 3. személy: goes.

drill.q: I ___ what you mean.
drill.why: Az understand állapotige, nem áll -ing alakban.

drill.q: We ___ in a hotel until our flat is ready.
___ you usually have breakfast at home?

topics.title: Past simple és past continuous
topics.intro: A past simple a lezárt múltbeli eseményekre, a past continuous a múltban épp folyamatban lévő háttérre való. Történetmesélésnél a kettő együtt jár: a háttér folyamatos, a közbejövő esemény egyszerű.

head: Past simple
Past continuous
rows: I was working, they were working
folyamatban lévő háttér egy adott pillanatban

points: Egymás utáni események: I got up, had a shower and left.
Háttér + esemény: I was cooking when the phone rang.
Két párhuzamos háttér: While I was working, he was watching TV.
Did után alapalak: Did you see? (nem: Did you saw?)
mistakes: Did you went? → Did you go?
I was go → I went / I was going
When I was arriving… → When I arrived… (rövid esemény)

drill.q: I ___ TV when you called.
drill.why: Háttér a hívás pillanatában: past continuous.

drill.q: Yesterday I ___ my keys.
Did you ___ the news?
While she ___, it started to rain.
When the film ended, we ___ home.

topics.title: Present perfect vagy past simple?
topics.intro: A present perfect (have + 3. alak) a múltat a jelenhez köti: tapasztalat, eredmény, még tartó időszak. A past simple egy lezárt, megnevezett múltbeli időponthoz tartozik. A magyarban mindkettő múlt idő, ezért ezt sokáig keverik a tanulók.

head: Present perfect
Past simple
rows: I have seen, she has gone
ever, never, already, yet, just, for, since, so far
yesterday, last year, in 2010, ago, when…

points: Tapasztalat: Have you ever been to Japan?
Eredmény most: I've lost my phone. (most sincs meg)
Még tartó időszak: I've lived here for ten years. (most is itt lakom)
Megnevezett múlt: I lost my phone yesterday. (nem: I've lost… yesterday)
mistakes: I have seen him yesterday. → I saw him yesterday.
I live here since 2015. → I've lived here since 2015.
Did you ever…? → Have you ever…?

drill.q: I ___ to Paris three times.
We ___ the film last night.
She has worked here ___ 2019.
Have you finished your homework ___?
He ___ his leg, so he can't play today.
drill.why: Eredmény most (nem tud játszani): present perfect.

topics.title: Present perfect continuous
topics.intro: A present perfect continuous (have been + -ing) a múltban kezdődött és most is tartó (vagy épp befejeződött) tevékenység időtartamát hangsúlyozza: Mióta? Mennyi ideje?

head: Present perfect continuous
Present perfect simple
rows: I've been writing emails all morning.

points: Mióta tart: How long have you been learning English?
Látható nyom: You look tired. Have you been running?
Állapotigékkel simple marad: I've known her for years. (nem: I've been knowing)
mistakes: I am learning English for two years. → I've been learning English for two years.
How long are you waiting? → How long have you been waiting?

drill.q: I ___ for you for an hour!
drill.why: Múltban kezdődött és most is tart.

drill.q: She's tired because she ___ all day.
I've ___ three chapters so far.
How long have you ___ each other?
It ___ since this morning.

topics.title: Past perfect
topics.intro: A past perfect (had + 3. alak) a múlt előtti múlt: ami egy másik múltbeli esemény előtt már megtörtént. Történetmesélésben segít világossá tenni a sorrendet.

head: Példa
rows: had + 3. alak: I had finished, she had left
had been + -ing: I had been waiting for an hour when he arrived.

points: Sorrend: When we arrived, the film had already started.
Függő beszédben: She said she had lost her keys.
Harmadik feltételes: If I had known, I would have come.
Ha a sorrend egyértelmű (after, before), past simple is jó: After he left, I went to bed.
mistakes: When I arrived, she already left. → When I arrived, she had already left.
I had went → I had gone

drill.q: When we got to the station, the train ___.
She was tired because she ___ well.
drill.why: Az előző éjszaka a fáradtság előtt volt.

drill.q: I ___ never seen snow before I moved to Canada.
He told me he ___ the job.
drill.why: Függő beszédben a múlt még régebbre tolódik.

drill.q: They had ___ for hours when the rescue team found them.

topics.title: A jövő: will, going to, present continuous
topics.intro: Az angolban nincs egyetlen jövő idő. A will spontán döntés, ígéret és jóslat; a going to szándék és látható jel; a present continuous megbeszélt program; a present simple menetrend.

head: Forma
Mikor
Példa
rows: spontán döntés, ígéret, vélemény a jövőről
I'll help you. I think it will rain.
I'm going to learn Spanish. Look at the clouds – it's going to rain.

points: Spontán: The phone's ringing. – I'll get it!
Szándék: We're going to buy a new car next year.
Megbeszélt: She's flying to Rome on Friday.
Időhatározói mellékmondatban nincs will: When I get home, I'll call you. (nem: When I will get home)
mistakes: When I will arrive, I call you. → When I arrive, I'll call you.
I will meet Tom tomorrow (ha már megbeszéltétek) → I'm meeting Tom tomorrow.

drill.q: It's cold in here. – I ___ close the window.
Look at those clouds! It ___ rain.
I ___ my dentist at 3 tomorrow. It's in my calendar.
The film ___ at 8 p.m. tonight.
I'll call you when I ___ home.
drill.why: A when után jelen idő áll a jövő helyett.

topics.title: Feltételes mondatok: 0, 1, 2
topics.intro: A feltételes mondatok aszerint különböznek, mennyire valószínű a feltétel. A legfontosabb szabály: az if-es tagmondatba nem kerül will vagy would.

head: Típus
If-tagmondat
Főmondat
Jelentés
rows: mindig igaz: If you heat ice, it melts.
valós lehetőség: If it rains, I'll stay home.
képzeletbeli, valószínűtlen: If I had money, I'd travel.

points: Az if-mondat lehet elöl vagy hátul: I'll stay home if it rains.
Második típusban a to be: If I were you… (were minden személyben, főleg tanácsnál)
unless = if not: Unless you hurry, you'll miss the bus.
mistakes: If it will rain, I stay home. → If it rains, I'll stay home.
If I would have money… → If I had money…

drill.q: If you ___ water to 100°C, it boils.
If it ___ tomorrow, we'll cancel the picnic.
If I ___ rich, I'd buy a house by the sea.
What ___ you do if you lost your job?
___ you study, you won't pass.

topics.title: Harmadik és vegyes feltételes
topics.intro: A harmadik feltételes a múltról szól, ami már nem változtatható meg: mi lett volna, ha. A vegyes feltételes a múltbeli feltétel jelenbeli következményét mutatja.

head: Típus
If-tagmondat
Főmondat
Példa
rows: If I had known, I would have helped.
If I had taken the job, I would be rich now.

points: Bánat, kritika: If you had listened, you wouldn't have made that mistake.
could / might have: If we had left earlier, we might have caught the train.
Kiejtésben: would have = would've /wʊdəv/, gyakran rövidül: I'd have.
mistakes: If I would have known… → If I had known…
If I had knew → If I had known

drill.q: If I ___ about the party, I would have come.
She would have passed if she ___ harder.
If he hadn't missed the bus, he ___ late.
If I had saved money, I ___ a car now.
We ___ caught the train if we had hurried.

topics.title: Szenvedő szerkezet
topics.intro: A szenvedő szerkezetben a cselekvés tárgya kerül előre, és a be megfelelő alakja + 3. alak áll. Akkor használjuk, ha a cselekvő ismeretlen, mindegy, vagy a cselekvés a fontos.
points: Cselekvő by-jal: The book was written by Agatha Christie.
Hivatalos szövegben gyakori: Applications must be submitted by Friday.
Kauzatív: I had my hair cut. (levágattam, nem én vágtam)
mistakes: The house was build in 1900. → The house was built in 1900.
English speaks here. → English is spoken here.

drill.q: This bridge ___ in 1849.
Coffee ___ in Brazil.
The results will ___ next week.
My car has ___ stolen!
drill.why: Present perfect szenvedő: has been + 3. alak.

drill.q: I'm having my car ___ tomorrow.

topics.title: Függő beszéd
topics.intro: Ha elmondjuk, mit mondott valaki, az igeidő általában egyet hátralép (backshift), és a névmások, időhatározók is változnak.

head: Egyenes beszéd
Függő beszéd
rows: She said she would call me.
She asked me where I lived.

points: say vagy tell: said (that)…, told me (that)… – a tell után kell valaki: He told me… (nem: He told that…)
Kérdésben nincs kérdő szórend: She asked where I lived. (nem: where did I live)
Kérés, utasítás: He asked me to wait. She told me not to worry.
Időhatározók: today → that day, tomorrow → the next day, here → there.
mistakes: She said me… → She told me… / She said…
He asked where did I work. → He asked where I worked.

drill.q: "I'm busy." → She said she ___ busy.
He ___ me that he was leaving.
She asked me where I ___.
"Don't be late." → He told us ___ late.
"I will help." → She said she ___ help.

topics.title: Kötelesség és engedély: must, have to, can
topics.intro: A must és a have to is kötelességet fejez ki, de a tagadó alakjuk egészen mást jelent: mustn't = tilos, don't have to = nem kell (de szabad).

head: Forma
Jelentés
Példa
rows: I have to wear a uniform.
You can park here. You can't park here.

points: A must-nak nincs múlt ideje: I had to work yesterday.
Kérdés: Do I have to…? / Can I…? / May I…? (udvariasabb)
need to / needn't: You needn't worry.
mistakes: You don't must… → You mustn't… / You don't have to…
I must to go. → I must go.
Yesterday I must work. → Yesterday I had to work.

drill.q: You ___ smoke in the hospital. It's forbidden.
It's Sunday, so I ___ get up early.
Yesterday I ___ work until nine.
___ I open the window?
You look ill. You ___ go home.

topics.title: Következtetés: must, might, can't (have)
topics.intro: A módbeli igékkel azt is kifejezzük, mennyire vagyunk biztosak valamiben. Múltbeli következtetéshez have + 3. alak jön.

head: Biztosság
Jelen
Múlt
rows: He might / may / could be ill.
He might have missed the bus.

points: A must ellentéte itt can't (nem mustn't!): He can't be hungry, he's just eaten.
should have: kritika, bánat: You should have told me.
Kiejtés: must have = /mʌstəv/, can't have = /kɑːntəv/.
mistakes: He mustn't be at home (ha következtetés) → He can't be at home.
She must left → She must have left.

drill.q: The lights are on. They ___ be at home.
He ___ be hungry – he's just had lunch.
She's late. She ___ have missed the train.
The ground is wet. It must ___ rained.
You ___ have told me! I would have helped.

topics.title: Névelők: a / an / the / semmi
topics.intro: A magyarban is van névelő, de máshol használjuk. Az angol a / an az első említés, a the a már ismert vagy egyedi dolog; általánosításnál többes számban és megszámlálhatatlan főnévnél nincs névelő.

head: Eset
Névelő
Példa
rows: első említés, egy a sok közül
the sun, the internet, the Danube
Dogs are friendly. I like music.
have lunch, play tennis, speak English

points: an magánhangzó-HANG előtt: an hour, an umbrella, de a university (/juː/), a European.
Országok: Hungary – de the UK, the USA, the Netherlands.
Hangszerek: play the piano.
Intézmények funkcióban: go to school / bed / work (névelő nélkül).
mistakes: I like the music. (általában) → I like music.
She is doctor. → She's a doctor.
I go to the school every day. (diákként) → I go to school every day.

drill.q: She's ___ engineer.
___ life is beautiful.
Can you close ___ door, please?
I play ___ guitar.
He's ___ honest man.

topics.title: Megszámlálható és megszámlálhatatlan, mennyiségek
topics.intro: Egyes főnevek nem számolhatók (water, money, advice, information, furniture, news), ezért nincs többes számuk és a / an sem állhat előttük. A mennyiségszavak is ehhez igazodnak.

head: Megszámlálható
Megszámlálhatatlan
rows: many books, a lot of books
much money, a lot of money
a piece of furniture, a piece of advice

points: Kijelentésben a lot of természetesebb: I have a lot of friends.
some kijelentésben, any kérdésben és tagadásban: some milk, any milk?
Magyarul számolható, angolul nem: advice, information, news, furniture, luggage, homework.
mistakes: an advice → a piece of advice / some advice
informations → information
The news are… → The news is…

drill.q: How ___ money do you need?
Can I give you some ___?
There are only ___ eggs left.
We've got ___ time, let's hurry.
The news ___ very good today.

topics.title: Fokozás
topics.intro: Rövid melléknevek -er, -est végződést kapnak, a hosszabbak more, most szót. Néhány rendhagyó alakot külön meg kell tanulni.
points: Összehasonlítás: than – She's taller than me.
Egyenlőség: as … as – He's as tall as his father. Not as … as: It's not as cold as yesterday.
Fokozás erősítése: much / far / a bit cheaper.
Párhuzam: the more, the better.
mistakes: more cheap → cheaper
more better → better
She's taller as me. → She's taller than me.

drill.q: This hotel is ___ than the other one.
It's the ___ film I've ever seen.
She's as tall ___ her brother.
This exercise is ___ difficult than the first.
The ___ you practise, the better you get.

topics.title: Vonatkozó mellékmondatok
topics.intro: A vonatkozó névmás (who, which, that, where, whose) köti össze a főnevet a róla szóló mellékmondattal. A magyar „aki, ami, ahol, akinek a…” megfelelői.

head: Névmás
Mire
Példa
rows: the book that changed my life
the city where I was born
the man whose dog bit me

points: Tárgyként elhagyható: the film (that) we saw.
Vesszős (kiegészítő) mellékmondatban nincs that: My brother, who lives in Paris, is a chef.
Elöljáró a végén (beszélt nyelv): the man I was talking to.
mistakes: The man which… → The man who…
the city which I was born → the city where I was born
My brother, that lives… → My brother, who lives…

drill.q: The woman ___ lives next door is a doctor.
This is the hotel ___ we stayed last year.
I met a man ___ car had broken down.
The book ___ I'm reading is great.
Budapest, ___ is the capital, has two parts.

topics.title: -ing vagy to + ige
topics.intro: Bizonyos igék után -ing alak, mások után to + ige áll. Ezt szinte csak megtanulni lehet, de vannak csoportok, amik segítenek.

head: Után
Alak
Példák
rows: enjoy, finish, mind, avoid, suggest, keep, miss, practise
want, decide, hope, plan, need, promise, afford, manage
I'm interested in learning. Thanks for coming.

points: Az -ing lehet alany: Swimming is good for you.
look forward to + -ing: I'm looking forward to seeing you. (a to itt elöljáró!)
would like + to: I'd like to come.
mistakes: I enjoy to read. → I enjoy reading.
I'm looking forward to see you. → …to seeing you.
I want going. → I want to go.

drill.q: I don't mind ___ for you.
We've decided ___ a new car.
I'm looking forward to ___ you.
Thanks for ___ me.
He stopped ___ to check the map.

topics.title: Kérdések és question tag
topics.intro: Az angol kérdésben segédige kell (do, does, did, vagy a be / have / modális ige), és felcserélődik a szórend. A question tag („ugye?”) a mondat végén ellenkező előjelű.

head: Típus
Példa
rows: Do you like it? Are you ready? Can she swim?
Where do you live? What did she say?
It's cold, isn't it? You don't smoke, do you?
Could you tell me where the station is?

points: Ha az alanyra kérdezünk, nincs do: Who lives here? (nem: Who does live here?)
Beágyazott kérdésben állító szórend: Do you know what time it is?
I am → aren't I? (I'm late, aren't I?)
mistakes: Where you live? → Where do you live?
Who did call you? → Who called you?
Can you tell me where is the station? → …where the station is?

drill.q: Where ___ you work?
Who ___ the window?
You're coming tonight, ___?
She doesn't eat meat, ___?
Do you know what time ___?

topics.title: Elöljárók: idő és hely
topics.intro: Az in / on / at az angol egyik legtöbb fejtörést okozó része. Időben: at a pontos időpont, on a nap, in a hosszabb időszak. Helyen: at pont, on felület, in belül.

head: at
on
in
rows: at 7 o'clock, at night, at the weekend
on Monday, on 3rd May, on my birthday
in May, in 2020, in summer, in the morning
at the station, at home, at work
on the table, on the wall, on the bus
in the box, in London, in the car

points: Járművek: on the bus / train / plane, de in the car / taxi.
Nincs elöljáró: next week, last year, this morning, tomorrow.
arrive in (városban, országban), arrive at (épületben, állomáson).
mistakes: in Monday → on Monday
at the summer → in summer
I arrived to London. → I arrived in London.

drill.q: The meeting is ___ Tuesday.
I was born ___ 1990.
See you ___ six o'clock.
She's ___ the bus.
We arrived ___ the airport late.

topics.title: used to, be used to, get used to
topics.intro: Három hasonló szerkezet, három jelentés. A used to + ige régi szokás; a be used to + -ing hozzászokottság; a get used to + -ing a hozzászokás folyamata.

head: Szerkezet
Jelentés
Példa
rows: I'm used to getting up early.
I'm getting used to driving on the left.
Every summer we would go to the lake.

points: Kérdés és tagadás: Did you use to…? I didn't use to like coffee.
Jelen szokásra nincs used to: I usually get up at 7. (nem: I use to)
mistakes: I use to play tennis every week. → I usually play tennis every week.
I'm used to get up early. → I'm used to getting up early.

drill.q: I ___ live in Szeged, but now I live in Pécs.
She's used to ___ long hours.
It took me months to get used to ___ on the left.
Did you ___ to play the piano?
When we were kids, we ___ play in the street every evening.

topics.title: Wish és if only
topics.intro: A wish-sel azt fejezzük ki, amit másképp szeretnénk. Jelenről múlt idővel, múltról past perfecttel beszélünk, mások zavaró viselkedéséről would-dal.

head: Mire
Szerkezet
Példa
rows: I wish I had more time.
I wish I had studied harder.
I wish you would stop talking.

points: Az if only erősebb: If only I had listened!
A to be-nél were is áll: I wish I were taller.
Saját magunkra nem használunk would-ot: I wish I had… (nem: I wish I would have)
mistakes: I wish I have a car. → I wish I had a car.
I wish I didn't say that. (múlt) → I wish I hadn't said that.

drill.q: I wish I ___ more money.
I wish I ___ that. It was a mistake.
I wish you ___ stop interrupting me!
If only I ___ speak Japanese!
I wish it ___ summer already.

topics.title: Phrasal verbs (kétszavas igék)
topics.intro: A phrasal verb ige + határozószó (vagy elöljáró), és a jelentése gyakran nem következik a részekből: give up = feladni, abbahagyni. A beszélt angolban nagyon gyakoriak.

head: Típus
Szórend
Példa
rows: look after the kids, get on the bus
főnév mindkét helyen, névmás csak középen
turn off the light / turn the light off / turn it off
The plane took off. Grow up!

points: Névmás mindig középen: Pick it up. (nem: Pick up it.)
Hármas: look forward to, get on with, run out of.
Gyakori: find out (kideríteni), turn down (elutasítani), put off (elhalasztani), come up with (kitalálni).
mistakes: Turn off it. → Turn it off.
I'm looking forward to see you. → …to seeing you.

drill.q: Please turn ___ off when you leave.
We've run out ___ milk.
She finally gave ___ smoking.
Can you look ___ my cat this weekend?
They had to put ___ the meeting until Friday.
